_about: UI30 (2026-11-07, owner 09:47 #16): skills that are thematic to introduce at each main map (sub-maps not needed), shown as a small 'Sugg. Intro' pill in the admin Map cards window (ui19McSkillsHTML). Picked by Claude from the map's theme (its blurb), its fields and boons, the skills its cards carry (2026-11-07), the existing intro keyword (canonical/map-keywords.json) and what earlier maps already introduce; no skill is suggested twice along the road. A suggestion that no card on the map has yet still shows as a tile. Shown only: it changes no list, card or pack. Keys are map ids; values are [{skill, why}].
